boundedIssueWriteAuthorizationMetadata.reason: Thirteen native issue-record child mutation route forms use the owned authorization reader with the literal original ID/body/alias extraction and query authority. The containing request owns selected headers, the generation token and the one-shot cache through its final consumer. Header-only data is never supplied as the complete authorization Bootstrap to application contexts; comment-action gates read only their selected closure and retain the separate current-account override. Off mode does not read or change the request; all other issue routes keep the original builder. The actual middleware/header table, route-dispatch guard and policy differential cover this boundary. Child callback writers, create/update/bootstrap and legacy issue aliases remain separately pending.
